analysis: Disagreed with the prior pass's accept recommendation. The revised scene is a floor plan with extruded walls: two routes drawn as rods on one plane, a booth, and doorways. Every relationship lies in that plane, so depth and orbit add nothing; the walls only add occlusion.

The counterfactual (route × enforcement placement) is real teaching content beyond the video: protecting the direct entrance leaves the shell route writing r42. But it is a 2 × 3 lookup whose outcome is carried by the caption and a teleported figure. A 2D route diagram shows the same reachability with less ambiguity, which the prior intent itself conceded.

Found a confound in the current interaction: selecting any entrance protection also raises the guard barrier, so two variables change at once. This weakens the counterfactual further; not repaired because the candidate is omitted.
